why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Earn page Go to the Drake Earn page and find the AUSD DLP Vault, which carries the "2x Points" tag.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Connect your wallet on the app. The Earn page asks you to connect a wallet before it shows your positions and earnings.

3 Step 3 : Deposit AUSD into the vault Deposit AUSD into the vault and you receive dAUSD, a share of the vault. Read how the vault works in the Drake docs first, since the vault takes the other side of trades.
4 Step 4 : Look at the Leaderboard and Rewards tabs Open the Leaderboard and the Rewards tab from the app menu to see what they show.
